newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: J.B. Were Capital plans unsecured note issue.
newsitem.headline: J.B. Were Capital plans unsecured note issue.

text.p: J.B. Were Capital Markets Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to raise up to A$210 million from the issue of up to 70 million unsecured Foster's Brewing Group Ltd 7.75 percent notes at A$3.00 each.
The brokerage firm said each note was exchangeable into Foster's share at any time between September 30, 1997 and February 28, 2002.
J.B. Were Capital said it would apply to the Australian Stock Exchange for listing of the notes.
Funds raised would be used for general working capital.
The issue follows the previous listing of J.B. Were Capital's A$58 million 9.0 percent Djerriwarrh series and the A$104 million 8.75 percent NAB series.
